The '''Royal castle''' was the seat of government in the [[Tammuz-an capital city|capital]] of [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]].

==History==
The castle encompassed the [[Tower (Tammuz-an Royal castle)|tower]] that served as the site of the ritual of royal succession on [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]]. Inside the castle, the rulers were seated on a throne encompassed by a massive statue.<ref name="TNK" /> When in negotiations with foreign dignitiaries, [[King/Legends|King]] Julpa used a separate meeting room that contained thrones for the leader of each delegation.<ref name="TROKR">{{DroidsCite|The Revenge of Kybo Ren}}</ref>

The fortress contained a vast, [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]-old dungeon with an extensive system of tunnels. Dangers inside the dungeon included a pit containing a [[durkii]], hallways lined with ancient [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], a [[Magma/Legends|lava]] pool, as well as rooms with trap doors and closing walls. [[Mon Julpa]]'s [[Mon Julpa's father|father]] had taught him about a secret entrance into the dungeon, which was used in an attempt to reach the ceremonial tower in secrecy.<ref name="TNK" /> The dungeon also contained a prison, which was used to house criminals such as the pirate captain [[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]] and [[Pirates of Tarnoonga|his gang]].<ref name="TROKR" />

The castle also had a massive [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] where [[Groundcar/Legends|groundcars]], [[Side Gunner]]s, as well as several squadrons of [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearhead]] fighters,<ref name="TROKR" /> [[Imperial Sniper]] vehicles, [[Floater-935]]s and [[One-Man Sand Skimmer|Ubrikkian Airhooks]] were stationed.<ref name="TNK" />
